content.short: M0 is a decentralized infrastructure layer for institutionally issued stablecoins backed by real-world assets.
content.description:
M0 is an innovative decentralized infrastructure protocol designed to facilitate the institutional issuance of cryptographically-backed stablecoins. Rather than being a single stablecoin issuer, M0 provides the foundational layer that allows various financial institutions to mint their own digital dollars, such as the $M stablecoin, backed by high-quality real-world assets (RWAs) like short-term US Treasuries. This approach aims to bring institutional-grade liquidity and compliance to the decentralized finance ecosystem.

Often described as the "Stripe for stablecoins," M0 simplifies the process of tokenizing traditional assets while maintaining robust cryptographic security and transparency. The platform operates on Ethereum and is built to be highly interoperable, enabling institutions to integrate digital currencies into their existing workflows. Through its focus on regulatory alignment and professional-grade infrastructure, M0 is bridging the gap between traditional finance and the next generation of decentralized monetary systems.
